market_thesis: The 24 Aug U.S. session was a technology-led de-risking move into a catalyst-heavy week: lower long yields did not offset AI-hardware valuation, policy and earnings uncertainty. The next test is whether consumer, inflation/growth and NVIDIA evidence stabilise the valuation debate rather than merely shift risk between sectors.

previous_thesis_review.prior_focus: 24 Aug weekend thesis: PCE/GDP, NVIDIA and Jackson Hole must jointly test growth, inflation and AI capex.
previous_thesis_review.evidence: The next completed U.S. session showed tech-led weakness before those scheduled tests occurred; official results were not yet available.

this_week.official_boundary: At report cutoff, the latest official release was July; August was scheduled, not a known result.
this_week.positive: A resilient reading without a further deterioration in expectations supports the consumer-resilience leg of the soft-landing thesis.
this_week.negative: A material decline, especially in expectations or labour-market assessments, raises the risk that growth support is weakening.

this_week.event: GDP second estimate and July Personal Income & Outlays / PCE
this_week.official_boundary: Scheduled by BEA; no result was available at the 25 Aug report cutoff.
this_week.positive: Growth remains orderly and price pressure does not reaccelerate, allowing long yields to stabilise.
this_week.negative: A hotter inflation signal or rate-sensitive growth concern renews discount-rate pressure.

this_week.official_boundary: Officially scheduled; all revenue, Blackwell cadence and guidance outcomes remain unknown before release.
this_week.positive: Data-centre demand, delivery cadence and forward commentary provide evidence that AI infrastructure spending remains visible.
this_week.negative: Cautious supply, customer-capex or demand commentary extends AI-hardware de-risking.

this_week.event: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium / Warsh keynote
this_week.when: 27–29 Aug; Warsh keynote 28 Aug 10:00 ET / 22:00 HKT
this_week.official_boundary: The Kansas City Fed confirmed the symposium dates; the Federal Reserve calendar confirmed Warsh's keynote.
this_week.positive: Communication reduces uncertainty around the policy and long-yield framework.
this_week.negative: Inflation, fiscal or policy-framework concerns keep the long-end risk premium elevated.
